_comment: Skill Repo Spec v1 s9 -- every path in this repo belongs to exactly one class.
TOOL    = code, docs, and metrics ABOUT THE TOOL. Public.
FIXTURE = LIFELIKE test data, produced by a generator so a pasted real record fails at commit.
DATA    = anything a REAL RUN produced. Never in this public repo.
data_sealed = a path that HELD real data, was purged, and must stay dead.
Enforced by guards/tools/data_boundary.py in .githooks and in CI.
_audited: 2026-09-27, at creation, by reading every write site in src/convo_chain. The library keeps no run data of its own and has no companion repo: its only persistent state is an in-process LRU index cache that never touches disk. There are exactly two writes. (1) fork() writes ONE new <uuid>.jsonl into the project directory of the source transcript, under the session root the CALLER passes as an absolute path; a relative root is refused (Unavailable), the library reads no environment variable, and the write is refused with code inside_repo when that directory or any parent holds .git, so a fork can never become a file of this or any other work tree. (2) The CLI's `export --out FILE` writes the Markdown the operator asked for, exclusive create, and refuses the same inside_repo case. Nothing is written relative to this repo, there is no in-repo fallback, and the test suite builds every transcript synthetically inside pytest's tmp_path, so no FIXTURE file is committed either. The empty lists below are therefore a finding, not a default.
_armed: The empty lists are re-tested on every commit: data_boundary check 4 runs off the TRACKED FILE LIST, so a file wearing the shape of real-run output fails whether or not it is declared here. Calibration: until fleet-guards 2f1edb1 the shared RUN_SHAPES recognised none of the names this tool writes (measured 2026-09-27 with `data_boundary.py --explain`: 1 of 6 schematic names matched, and only the generic transcript.jsonl ledger name), so the probes waited in _run_shape_probes_pending. That commit added the Claude Code transcript shapes (a <uuid>.jsonl or .jsonl.gz session file and its .fork-<uuid>.tmp staging copy, subagents/**/agent-<id>.jsonl, a <uuid>/ sidecar directory, an encoded project directory), and the five names below now all match, so they moved into _run_shape_probes verbatim and `--calibration` reports this repo calibrated. One name stays pending on purpose: an exported Markdown file carries no shape that separates it from documentation, and a shared shape broad enough to catch it would redden every README in the fleet. The export is refused inside any git work tree (code inside_repo), and .gitignore still excludes *.jsonl, *.jsonl.gz, .fork-*.tmp and exports/ as defence in depth.
